verdict.rationale: Raygun documents some programmatic surfaces: a Deployments API, source map, dSYM and ProGuard uploads via API with an external access token, and an official MCP server. However, the documented workflows for triage (status changes), export and settings are UI-driven, and no OpenAPI spec was found, so UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST API covering error groups, statuses, export and settings, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, and independent evidence that the API matches the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files, Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun
you can also manually upload source maps either through our website using the `JS source map center` or via our API
